name: Ochiteiku Wakazuma Maiko
original_name: 堕ちていく若妻麻衣子
source: The Mikami family enjoyed a perfect marital life. That was until a certain mans appearance completely changed everything. The wife Maiko is caught in his trap and the husband is frantically struggling to protect his marriage. All the while Maiko is being trained.
translation: 三上一家过着完美的婚姻生活。直到某个男人的出现，彻底改变了一切。妻子舞子陷入了他的陷阱，丈夫则疯狂地努力保护自己的婚姻。舞妓一直在接受训练。
